neighbours.label: Words that start with the letters Bez- (Latin script) or бес-/без- (Cyrillic) inside a longer word, whatever they mean: Bez- surnames and places, the word bezel, and Russian -less compounds (бес-/без- + adjective or adverb). Not the meaning 'without' itself: English without/-less, Spanish sin, Korean 무 and the separate Russian word без stay quiet; German Bezahlung/Bezug are weak. Known leak: the name Bessemer (~0.4); Bess and Bessie stay quiet.
neighbours.short: words starting with Bez- / бес-, без- (spelling, not 'without')

Feeders-first arm: feeders include machine-guessed 'без' (L1/N2848-), Korean ' 무' (L24/N73-), Spanish ' sin' (L6/N2937+), suggesting a cross-language 'without' idea, but probes showed only the letters fire.
